## Proposed change

Describe exactly what is added or corrected. Link to the relevant *public* evidence already in this repository.

## Verification and provenance

Record source revision, observations, dates, artifact hashes or other reproducible checks as applicable. Distinguish verified facts from interpretation.

## Publication safety

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private messages, sensitive identifiers or unpublished evidence.
- [ ] No claim of a vulnerability, vendor response, remediation or severity without documented support.
- [ ] No active exploit instructions or unpatched sensitive disclosure.
- [ ] Scope and factual limitations are clear.

For sensitive reports, arrange a private reporting channel instead of filing a public PR.
